skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept and role of labour organization in organizations.
Understand the concept and role of standardization in organizations.
Understand the concept and role of labour standards in organizations.
Understand the concept and role of labour measurement in organizations.
Understand the concept and role of labour management in organizations.
Analyze and evaluate various activities related to labour organization and standardization.
Propose solutions to problems related to labour organization and standardization.
Effectively present and discuss topics related to labour organization and standardization.
Continuously learn and improve knowledge on labour organization and standardization.
